tests: A checkbox group built from FormCheck, FormCheckInput, FormCheckLabel and Feedback, with spread props, forwardRef, a theme context and a form context consumer, and a keyed list.
adaptation: FormCheck.tsx, FormCheckInput.tsx, FormCheckLabel.tsx, Feedback.tsx, FormContext.tsx, ThemeProvider useBootstrapPrefix and ElementChildren hasChildOfType joined in one file with types, propTypes and docs removed. classnames is replaced by a local classNames, hasChildOfType reads the children array directly instead of React.Children.toArray (the harness has no Preact mapping for Children), and Object.assign statics are dropped. bump('Child') is added to FormCheckLabel. CheckGroup is new: it renders the keyed list, holds state and exposes toggle and clear on globalThis.
